chronology: Operational clarification of two originally gated rotation hypotheses after native controls/early mechanism results, before any rotation-arm outcome. This is development research, not fresh confirmation.

stale_gate.recovery_episode: Completed observed nonoverlapping close-to-close price recovery using exact frozen selector validity, trough/reset, gross_recovery_ratio and maximum7dayrules. Includes completions in current partial UTC day. Not a confirmed sale or proof of obtainable profit.
stale_gate.missing_history: Require a fully tracked prior7dayinterval with >=274 valid actual bars in each of latest7 completedUTCdays; unavailable evidence denies. Gaps reset troughs and remain missing.
stale_gate.signed_24h: Exact finite positive completed closes at t and t-86400; current/anchor-1 <0

daily_forecast.intervals: Latest7 completed UTC daily intervals; exact positive finite boundary closes, seven returns require8boundaries.
daily_forecast.mean: Arithmetic mean of ALL seven signed simple gross boundary-close-to-close returns, including negative/zero days. No fitted weights, successful-cycle conditioning or forward-fill.
daily_forecast.missing: Any missing boundary or undercovered required day denies forecast.
daily_forecast.interpretation: Causal historical one-day marked-return estimator, not guaranteed future or liquidated profit.

fee_gate.candidate: First distinct normalized-base native-eligible candidate in original deterministic ranking with valid seven-return forecast, positive modeled new one-day marked gain and positive dollar delta. Ordinary spot exclusion, route/liquidity/native guard constraints remain.
fee_gate.replacement_budget_B: Fixed10.25 all-in forecast input; it is not cash authorization. Actual post-confirmation available owner cash, paircap, reserve and route minima determine admission; no external top-up.
fee_gate.loss: Full actual signed old-parent loss is recorded in realizedPnl. Existing unrealized loss is not subtracted again from the marked-equity dollar hurdle. No future exit price is used.
fee_gate.candidate_identity: Persist forecast candidate identity as an unfunded conditional replacement intention. After confirmed old-parent closure, admit only if still distinct/nativeeligible and all current guards pass; otherwise expire intention and report failure. Never claim a replacement fill from the forecast.

priority: ordinary native effective whole profit/protective exit
protected_state: An armed native profit floor always vetoes research loss rotation, including HARD_TARGET cases that otherwise override DTTP exits. Control behavior is unchanged when rotation is disabled.

execution.sell: Whole remaining parent quantity, tagged immutable order/parent; bypass174bps profit-floor only for this research-tagged order. No guaranteed fill.
execution.timing: Preserve native immediate next five-minute actual open; missing immediate candle expires intent. Do not wait across missing bars.
execution.price: Actual execution open*(1-slippage); realized fee at executed gross quote.
execution.capacity: Same native1% FOK minimum of decision-bar and execution-bar actual quote-volume; missing/minimum/identity guards remain.
execution.pending: Parent identity/quantity remain claimed until confirmed whole sale; no partial or hypothetical close releases a slot. Rejected/expired order leaves parent/lots/owner principal intact.
execution.replacement: Confirmed close first, then current-frame proposal if eligible/funded, then a subsequent modeled open. No anticipation or same-open replacement.

ownership.control_and_ordinary_sales: Same reviewedv2 PARK behavior and exact PRODUCTIVE/VCAP principal/loss and75/25 positive disposed-lot profit rules.
ownership.tagged_rotation_sales: After confirmed full-sale receipt, release exactly that receipt owned proceeds from any parking into their same owners. VCAP principal never becomes PRODUCTIVE cash. No unrelated parked receipt is released.
ownership.matched_adapter_gate: Separate immutablev3 adapter, source-bound synthetic review, and additional matchedcontrol. Neutral rotation-disabled financial source/body must equalv2; independently auditedv3 matchedcontrol precedes rotation candidates. All activev1/v2sources remain unchanged.

reporting: full actual signed old-parent realized loss and exitfees/slippage
confirmed closure and replacement order/fill linkage or explicitfailure
